topic: Fixing ml2_agg script error with ClickHouse
summary_markdown: The conversation addressed an error encountered while running the `ml2_agg` script. The issue was identified as a change in how JetBrains updated the ClickHouse driver, causing queries to run in separate sessions by default. A workaround was provided: rolling back the driver version and restarting the IDE/reconnecting tabs.
decisions: The error with `ml2_agg` is resolved by rolling back the ClickHouse driver version.
action_items: [p1] will roll back the ClickHouse driver version and restart the IDE to confirm the fix.
